capabilities: Collapse the outline view at a chosen heading level
Keep named headings open using wildcard patterns
Auto-collapse the outline when a note opens
Bind each heading level to its own command or hotkey
disambiguation: Not a heading or folding tool for the note text itself; it only collapses entries in the core Outline sidebar view.
extras: Requires the core Outline plugin to be enabled and its view open; commands show a notice and do nothing otherwise. README includes manual installation steps only.
intentEvidence: folds the core Outline view of the active note at a heading level you choose
problem: Obsidian's Outline view can only collapse items one by one, with no single command to show just H1 and H2 or a chosen level.

relations.evidence: folds the core Outline view of the active note at a heading level you choose

requires.name: Outline (core plugin, must be enabled with its view open)

summary: Plugin that folds the core Outline view of the active note to a chosen heading level, with wildcard-protected headings and optional auto-collapse.
